# TopologicalUpdateRule

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A local update function for NCA cells that depends on the connectivity pattern (topology) of neighboring cells, not just spatial proximity. Allows mapping of arbitrary network topologies onto neuromorphic substrates, enabling flexible and scalable reservoir designs.
